articles.title: Metaplanet to form securities arm through Siiibo acquisition
articles.snippet: Metaplanet will acquire Siiibo Securities and rename it Metaplanet Securities as it builds out Project Nova, its Bitcoin-centric finance strategy in Japan.

articles.title: OpenAI Wants a Price War With Anthropic—Is It Proving DeepSeek Right?
articles.snippet: Sam Altman is weighing drastic token price cuts to fight Anthropic. The problem is DeepSeek already made that argument for him—and for free.
